allowed_changes: use exact frozen VBR, MTUM, QUAL, TLT and SPY adjusted-close total-return proxy files
rebalance only at first common session of each calendar year
use identical historical USD/CNY conversion for every leg
comparison_gates: Sharpe > SPY buy-and-hold on identical total-return/FX window
expected_outputs: Factor-Duration, SPY buy-hold and cash CSVs
trade count, actual gross, minimum cash and fingerprint
follow_up_policy: After formal performance is viewed, do not alter factor membership, 25% weights, rebalance cadence or add timing filters inside this lineage. Any factor rotation or fifth asset is a new independent preregistered hypothesis.
forbidden_changes: dropping a weak factor after results
adding SPY, gold, cash or another fifth sleeve after results
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage or gross exposure above 100%
hypothesis: Long-only value, momentum and quality equity factor exposures represent distinct structural return premia, while long-duration Treasuries provide a macro duration source that can offset equity-factor stress. A fixed equal-weight annual portfolio of VBR, MTUM, QUAL and TLT may retain a materially higher growth rate than defensive all-weather portfolios while reducing the drawdown and improving the Sharpe ratio of a single broad-equity holding, without shorting, leverage, timing thresholds or frequent trading.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
research_basis: AQR Understanding Alternative Risk Premia: diversification across value, momentum and defensive/risk premia can improve risk-adjusted outcomes because premia and asset-group correlations are imperfect
This implementation is deliberately long-only because project policy forbids shorting and leverage; it is not claimed to reproduce market-neutral AQR factors
selection_metric: No factor weighting or rebalance search. Exactly four 25% sleeves and annual rebalance. Individual component factors were studied previously, but this combined portfolio performance has not been viewed. Validation, objective and SPY comparison are separate ATM-SVP-3 axes.

shared_rules.rebalance: first common session each calendar year
